name: How long does a typical shower enclosure installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower enclosure installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard shower enclosure installation typically takes 1 to 2 days, assuming the shower pan and tiling are already complete. This timeframe can vary based on the complexity of the design, such as custom glass panels or intricate hardware, and site conditions. Our team ensures efficient work, minimizing disruption to your home in locations such as Dublin or Fremont.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most shower enclosure installations take 1-2 days, but this can vary with design complexity and site conditions.
